environment.constraint: Read-only against V1/audit/V2/git; case inputs created only under REAUDIT/tests/cases.

source_review_notes.cli_except_clause: validate.py lines 46-49 catch only (DuplicateKeyError, ValueError); RecursionError/AttributeError/UnicodeEncodeError escape.
source_review_notes.json_loader: validator.py lines 74-97; decode then json.loads with object_pairs_hook; no depth guard; surrogates accepted when \u-escaped.
source_review_notes.schema_errors_nonfatal: validator.py lines 288-289 record E-SCHEMA issues but continue execution into unguarded .get() calls.
source_review_notes.evidence_lookup: validator.py lines 217-246 use evidence.get(eid); source_ref only truth-tested; no open()/filesystem dereference.
source_review_notes.relative_path_anchor: validate.py lines 33-36 anchor relative --state to ROOT (V2), not cwd; source reported as basename only (line 36).
source_review_notes.io_error_mapping: validator.py lines 77-80 map every OSError to E-FILE-NOT-FOUND.

surrogate_case_json_only.finding: --json-only avoids the print() UnicodeEncodeError because json_result uses json.dumps (ensure_ascii=True); the default human report does not.

source_ref_non_dereference.finding: Changing source_ref from a traversal string to a nonexistent absolute path changes only the 'Source:' basename line; validation output is otherwise byte-identical. No filesystem path is opened or dereferenced.

cli_help_option_inventory.finding: CLI has no evidence-path option; evidence is referenced exclusively by ID keys inside the state document.
